name: bingbot
description: Microsoft's crawler family: bingbot (desktop, mobile, and the evergreen Chrome-clause form), adidxbot (Bing Ads landing-page quality), and MicrosoftPreview (link unfurling in Microsoft products). ALL classify as crawler — the gateway serves them canonical HTML, never markdown (cloaking guardrail). This is also the Copilot path: Copilot answers from Bing's index and has no user agent of its own, so a merchant who wants to reach Copilot allows bingbot. UA strings here are transcribed from Microsoft's published crawler documentation rather than captured from our own traffic; replace a sample with a real capture the first time one is observed.
